assets.caption: Flanged Thermowell Connection T-15 — NPS 3/4 & UP, showing two installation configurations with labeled components including concentric and eccentric swages, butt weld elbowlets, and raised face weld neck flanges
assets.notes: Full-page engineering schematic showing two thermowell installation configurations. Upper configuration shows NPS 3/4 line with concentric swage (bevel large end, bevel small end), NPS 1-1/2 butt weld elbowlet, NPS 1-1/2 raised face weld neck flange, and NPS 3/4 thru NPS 1 line size detail. Lower configuration shows NPS 3 line size & up with NPS 1-1/2 butt weld elbowlet, NPS 1-1/2 raised face weld neck flange, line size x NPS 3 concentric reducer, and eccentric reducer details.
